Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Old Friend Belongings
Cardtype: Action
Clan: Ravnos
Bleed. This bleed is at +2 bleed against your prey if he or she has gained pool since your last turn.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Timo
Messages.Body:
Too complex too keep records i would say.

And endless talk about how many pool you had at the end of last turn.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
You don't need to keep a record. As soon as your prey has gained pool (even if he has lost the same amount or more), he is tagged.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> You don't need to keep a record. As soon as your prey has gained pool (even if he has lost the same amount or more), he is tagged.
>
That is keeping a record.

The one pool that your prey decides to pull back via a Blood Doll in his turn might easily be 10 or 15 minutes ago by the time it gets to your turn, on a busy 5 player table. (e.g. a couple of tense votes, a deck with a lot of vampires/actions, Una Freak Drive, Turbo Arika)

At that point, you might or might not have had this card in your hand. If you have only a few in your deck, it may be something you only play occasionally. You may not particularly want to draw attention to "I'M PLAYING THIS CARD SO LOOK YOU GOT POOL".
